debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging and developer UI features.

log_level.description: Log verbosity level (0=EMERG to 7=DEBUG). Use 4 for WARNING+ in production.

base_path.description: URL path prefix (e.g., '/icingaweb2') under which Icinga Web 2 is accessible. Must begin with '/' and no trailing slash.

auth_backend.description: Authentication backend type. Choose 'db' (local users) or 'ldap' for external auth.

host.description: LDAP server hostname or IP address.

port.description: LDAP server port (389 for LDAP, 636 for LDAPS).

bind_dn.description: Service account DN to bind with for searching users/groups.

bind_password.description: Password for the bind DN. Use secure storage (e.g., file with restricted permissions) in production.

user_base_dn.description: Base DN to search for users.

group_base_dn.description: Base DN to search for groups.

user_filter.description: LDAP filter for user entries (%s will be replaced with username).

group_filter.description: LDAP filter for groups (%s replaced with username or group name).

user_name_attribute.description: LDAP attribute used as the login name (e.g., 'uid', 'sAMAccountName').

user_display_name_attribute.description: LDAP attribute for user’s full display name (e.g., 'cn', 'displayName').

user_mail_attribute.description: LDAP attribute for user’s email address.

group_name_attribute.description: LDAP attribute used as the group name.

group_display_name_attribute.description: LDAP attribute for group display name (e.g., 'cn', 'displayName').

default.name: icingaweb_db
default.description: Database for Icinga Web 2 users, roles, and preferences.

resources.description: Named resource definitions. Required at minimum: 'icingaweb_db' (for local auth/users), and 'icinga2' (for monitoring backend).

name.description: Unique resource name (used by modules to reference this resource).

options.description: Key-value options specific to the resource type (e.g., host, dbname, username, password).

enabled_modules.description: List of modules to enable by default (e.g., 'monitoring', 'command', 'director', 'reactor').

disabled_modules.description: List of modules to explicitly disable.

hmac_secret_file.description: Path to the file containing the HMAC key for session signing (auto-generated on first start).

session_lifetime.description: Session validity period in seconds (e.g., 86400 = 24 hours).

enforce_https.description: Force HTTPS connections (set to true in production).

allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed hostnames/FQDNs for the web interface. Use ['*'] to allow all (not recommended in production).

default_timezone.description: Default timezone (IANA tz database name, e.g., 'Europe/Berlin').

config_path.description: Directory where this config.ini and modules are stored.

validate_config.description: Enable config validation at startup to catch syntax errors early.
